entries.comment: A Windows critical section is a Windows object that provides synchronization similar to that provided by a mutex object, except that a critical section can be used only by the threads of a single process. Critical section objects cannot be shared across processes. Event, mutex, and semaphore objects can also be used in a single-process application, but critical section objects provide a slightly…

entries.label: WindowsEvent
entries.comment: A Windows event is a notification record of an occurance of interest (system, security, application, etc.) on a Windows operating system.

entries.label: WindowsFilemapping
entries.comment: A Windows file mapping is the association of a file's contents with a portion of the virtual address space of a process within a Windows operating system. The system creates a file mapping object (also known as a section object) to maintain this association. A file view is the portion of virtual address space that a process uses to access the file's contents. File mapping allows the process to…

entries.label: WindowsHandle
entries.comment: A Windows handle is an abstract reference to a resource within the Windows operating system, such as a window, memory, an open file or a pipe. It is the mechanism by which applications interact with such resources in the Windows operating system.

entries.label: WindowsHook
entries.comment: A Windows hook is a mechanism by which an application can intercept events, such as messages, mouse actions, and keystrokes within the Windows operating system. A function that intercepts a particular type of event is known as a hook procedure. A hook procedure can act on each event it receives, and then modify or discard the event. [based on…

entries.label: WindowsMailslot
entries.comment: A Windows mailslot is is a pseudofile that resides in memory, and may be accessed using standard file functions. The data in a mailslot message can be in any form, but cannot be larger than 424 bytes when sent between computers. Unlike disk files, mailslots are temporary. When all handles to a mailslot are closed, the mailslot and all the data it contains are deleted. [based on…

entries.label: WindowsNetworkShare
entries.comment: A Windows network share is a Windows computer resource made available from one host to other hosts on a computer network. It is a device or piece of information on a computer that can be remotely accessed from another computer transparently as if it were a resource in the local machine. Network sharing is made possible by inter-process communication over the network. [based on…

entries.label: WindowsPEBinaryFile
entries.comment: A Windows PE binary file is a Windows portable executable (PE) file.

entries.label: WindowsPEBinaryFileFacet
entries.comment: A Windows PE binary file facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to a Windows portable executable (PE) file.

entries.label: WindowsPEOptionalHeader
entries.comment: A Windows PE optional header is a grouping of characteristics unique to the 'optional header' of a Windows PE (Portable Executable) file, consisting of a collection of metadata about the executable code structure of the file.

entries.label: WindowsPESection
entries.comment: A Windows PE section is a grouping of characteristics unique to a specific default or custom-defined region of a Windows PE (Portable Executable) file, consisting of an individual portion of the actual executable content of the file delineated according to unique purpose and memory protection requirements.

entries.label: WindowsPEFileHeader
entries.comment: A Windows PE file header is a grouping of characteristics unique to the 'header' of a Windows PE (Portable Executable) file, consisting of a collection of metadata about the overall nature and structure of the file.

entries.label: WindowsPrefetch
entries.comment: The Windows prefetch contains entries in a Windows prefetch file (used to speed up application startup starting with Windows XP).

entries.label: WindowsPrefetchFacet
entries.comment: A Windows prefetch facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to entries in the Windows prefetch file (used to speed up application startup starting with Windows XP).

entries.label: WindowsProcess
entries.comment: A Windows process is a program running on a Windows operating system.

entries.label: WindowsProcessFacet
entries.comment: A Windows process facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to a program running on a Windows operating system.

entries.label: WindowsRegistryHive
entries.comment: The Windows registry hive is a particular logical group of keys, subkeys, and values in a Windows registry (a hierarchical database that stores low-level settings for the Microsoft Windows operating system and for applications that opt to use the registry). [based on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windows_Registry]

entries.label: WindowsRegistryHiveFacet
entries.comment: A Windows registry hive facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to a particular logical group of keys, subkeys, and values in a Windows registry (a hierarchical database that stores low-level settings for the Microsoft Windows operating system and for applications that opt to use the registry). [based on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windows_Registry]

entries.label: WindowsRegistryKey
entries.comment: A Windows registry key is a particular key within a Windows registry (a hierarchical database that stores low-level settings for the Microsoft Windows operating system and for applications that opt to use the registry). [based on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windows_Registry]

entries.label: WindowsRegistryKeyFacet
entries.comment: A Windows registry key facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to a particular key within a Windows registry (A hierarchical database that stores low-level settings for the Microsoft Windows operating system and for applications that opt to use the registry). [based on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windows_Registry]

entries.label: WindowsRegistryValue
entries.comment: A Windows registry value is a grouping of characteristics unique to a particular value within a Windows registry (a hierarchical database that stores low-level settings for the Microsoft Windows operating system and for applications that opt to use the registry. [based on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windows_Registry]

entries.label: WindowsService
entries.comment: A Windows service is a specific Windows service (a computer program that operates in the background of a Windows operating system, similar to the way a UNIX daemon runs on UNIX). [based on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windows_service]

entries.label: WindowsServiceFacet
entries.comment: A Windows service facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to a specific Windows service (a computer program that operates in the background of a Windows operating system, similar to the way a UNIX daemon runs on UNIX). [based on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windows_service]

entries.label: WindowsSystemRestore
entries.comment: A Windows system restore is a capture of a Windows computer's state (including system files, installed applications, Windows Registry, and system settings) at a particular point in time such that the computer can be reverted to that state in the event of system malfunctions or other problems. [based on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/System_Restore]

entries.label: WindowsTask
entries.comment: A Windows task is a process that is scheduled to execute on a Windows operating system by the Windows Task Scheduler. [based on http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381311(v=vs.85).aspx]

entries.label: WindowsTaskFacet
entries.comment: A Windows Task facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to a Windows Task (a process that is scheduled to execute on a Windows operating system by the Windows Task Scheduler). [based on http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381311(v=vs.85).aspx]

entries.label: WindowsThread
entries.comment: A Windows thread is a single thread of execution within a Windows process.

entries.label: WindowsThreadFacet
entries.comment: A Windows thread facet is a grouping os characteristics unique to a single thread of execution within a Windows process.

entries.label: WindowsVolumeFacet
entries.comment: A Windows volume facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to a single accessible storage area (volume) with a single Windows file system. [based on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volume_(computing)]

entries.label: WindowsWaitableTime
entries.comment: A Windows waitable timer is a synchronization object within the Windows operating system whose state is set to signaled when a specified due time arrives. There are two types of waitable timers that can be created: manual-reset and synchronization. A timer of either type can also be a periodic timer. [based on https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/sync/waitable-timer-objects]

entries.label: WirelessNetworkConnection
entries.comment: A wireless network connection is a connection (completed or attempted) across an IEEE 802.11 standards-confromant digital network (a group of two or more computer systems linked together). [based on https://www.webopedia.com/TERM/N/network.html]

entries.label: WirelessNetworkConnectionFacet
entries.comment: A wireless network connection facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to a connection (completed or attempted) across an IEEE 802.11 standards-conformant digital network (a group of two or more computer systems linked together). [based on https://www.webopedia.com/TERM/N/network.html]

entries.label: WriteBlocker
entries.comment: A write blocker is a device that allows read-only access to storage mediums in order to preserve the integrity of the data being analyzed. Examples include Tableau, Cellibrite, Talon, etc.

entries.label: X509Certificate
entries.comment: A X.509 certificate is a public key digital identity certificate conformant to the X.509 PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) standard.

entries.label: X509CertificateFacet
entries.comment: A X.509 certificate facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to a public key digital identity certificate conformant to the X.509 PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) standard.

entries.label: X509V3ExtensionsFacet
entries.comment: An X.509 v3 certificate extensions facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to a public key digital identity certificate conformant to the X.509 v3 PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) standard.

entries.label: X509V3Certificate
entries.comment: An X.509 v3 certificate is a public key digital identity certificate conformant to the X.509 v3 PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) standard.

entries.label: passwordLastChanged
entries.comment: The date and time that the password was last changed.

entries.label: password
entries.comment: Specifies an authentication password.

entries.label: passwordType
entries.comment: The type of password, for instance plain-text or encrypted.

entries.label: isActive
entries.comment: Indicates whether the network connection is still active.

entries.label: expirationTime
entries.comment: The date and time at which the validity of the object expires.

entries.label: modifiedTime
entries.comment: The date and time at which the Object was last modified.

entries.label: observableCreatedTime
entries.comment: The date and time at which the observable object being characterized was created. This time pertains to an intrinsic characteristic of the observable object, and would be consistent across independent characterizations or observations of the observable object.

entries.label: accountIdentifier
entries.comment: The unique identifier for the account.

entries.label: accountType
entries.comment: The type of account, for instance bank, phone, application, service, etc.

entries.label: size
entries.comment: Specifies the size of the section, in bytes.

entries.label: isADBRootEnabled
entries.comment: Root access through the Android Debug Bridge (ADB) daemon observed to be enabled. [based on https://developer.android.com/studio/command-line/adb]

entries.label: isSURootEnabled
entries.comment: Root access through Linux SU binary observed to be enabled. [based on https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rooting_(Android)]

entries.label: androidID
entries.comment: A 64-bit number (expressed as a hexadecimal string), unique to each combination of app-signing key, user, and device. [based on https://developer.android.com/reference/android/provider/Settings.Secure#ANDROID_ID]

entries.label: androidFingerprint
entries.comment: A string that uniquely identifies a build of the Android operating system. [based on https://developer.android.com/reference/android/os/Build#FINGERPRINT]

entries.label: androidVersion
entries.comment: The user-visible version string. E.g., '1.0' or '3.4b5' or 'bananas'. This field is an opaque string. Do not assume that its value has any particular structure or that values of RELEASE from different releases can be somehow ordered. [based on https://developer.android.com/reference/android/os/Build.VERSION#RELEASE]

entries.label: antennaHeight
entries.comment: The height (in meters) of the antenna from the ground.

entries.label: azimuth
entries.comment: The median rotation in degrees around a vertical axis of the cell antenna sector accessed.

entries.label: elevation
entries.comment: The angle in degrees of the antenna from the local horizontal plane.

entries.label: horizontalBeamWidth
entries.comment: The width of the antenna beam in degrees.

entries.label: signalStrength
entries.comment: The strength of the antenna signal.

entries.label: skew
entries.comment: The angle in degrees of the radial rotation around its main beam direction.

entries.label: installDate
entries.comment: Specifies the date the operating system or application was installed.

entries.label: uninstallDate
entries.comment: Specifies the date the operating system or application was uninstalled.

entries.label: archiveType
entries.comment: The type of a file archive, e.g. ZIP, GZIP or RAR.

entries.label: bitRate
entries.comment: The bitrate of the audio in bits per second.

entries.label: duration
entries.comment: The duration of the phone call in seconds.

entries.label: audioType
entries.comment: The type of a audio. For example: music or speech.

entries.label: format
entries.comment: The format of the audio. For example: mp3 or flac.

entries.label: regionalInternetRegistry
entries.comment: specifies the name of the Regional Internet Registry (RIR) which allocated the IP address contained in a WHOIS entry.

entries.label: urlTargeted
entries.comment: The target of the bookmark.

entries.label: accessedTime
entries.comment: The date and time at which the Object was accessed.

entries.label: visitCount
entries.comment: Specifies the number of times a URL has been visited by a particular web browser.

entries.label: bookmarkPath
entries.comment: The folder containing the bookmark.

entries.label: isSecure
entries.comment: Is the cookie secure? If the cookie is secure it cannot be delivered over an unencrypted session such as http.

entries.label: cookieName
entries.comment: The name of the cookie.

entries.label: cookiePath
entries.comment: String representation of the path of the cookie.

entries.label: isPrivate
entries.comment: Is the event marked as private?

entries.label: eventStatus
entries.comment: The status of the event, for instance accepted, pending or cancelled.

entries.label: eventType
entries.comment: The type of the event, for example 'information', 'warning' or 'error'.

entries.label: recurrence
entries.comment: Recurrence of the event.

entries.label: subject
entries.comment: The subject of the email.

entries.label: callType
entries.comment: The type of a phone call,for example incoming, outgoing, missed.

entries.label: interceptedCallState
entries.comment: State of the call in a Call Detail Record (e.g. idle).

entries.label: cellSiteCountryCode
entries.comment: The country code represents the country of the cell site. For GSM, this is the Mobile Country Code (MCC).

entries.label: cellSiteIdentifier
entries.comment: Specifies the unique number used to identify each Cell Site within a location area code.

entries.label: cellSiteLocationAreaCode
entries.comment: The location area code is a unique number of current location area of the cell site. A location area is a set of cell site that are grouped together to optimize signalling. For GSM, this is the LAC.

entries.label: cellSiteNetworkCode
entries.comment: This code identifies the mobile operator of the cell site. For GSM, this is the Mobile Network Code (MNC) and for CMDA this is the network identifier (NID).

entries.label: cellSiteType
entries.comment: Specifies the technology used by the Cell Site (e.g., GSM, CDMA, or LTE).

entries.label: compressionRatio
entries.comment: The compression ratio of the compressed data.

entries.label: compressionMethod
entries.comment: The algorithm used to compress the data.

entries.label: biosDate
entries.comment: Specifies the date of the BIOS (e.g. the datestamp of the BIOS revision).

entries.label: biosReleaseDate
entries.comment: Specifies the date the BIOS was released.

entries.label: currentSystemDate
entries.comment: Specifies the current date on the system.

entries.label: localTime
entries.comment: Specifies the local time on the system.

entries.label: availableRam
entries.comment: Specifies the amount of physical memory available on the system, in bytes.

entries.label: totalRam
entries.comment: Specifies the total amount of physical memory present on the system, in bytes.

entries.label: biosManufacturer
entries.comment: Specifies the manufacturer of the BIOS.

entries.label: biosSerialNumber
entries.comment: Specifies the serial number of the BIOS.

entries.label: biosVersion
entries.comment: Specifies the version of the BIOS.

entries.label: cpu
entries.comment: Specifies the name of the CPU used by the system.

entries.label: cpuFamily
entries.comment: Specifies the name of the CPU family used by the system.

entries.label: gpu
entries.comment: Specifies the name of the GPU used by the system.

entries.label: gpuFamily
entries.comment: Specifies the name of the GPU family used by the system.

entries.label: hostname
entries.comment: Specifies the hostname of the system.

entries.label: processorArchitecture
entries.comment: Specifies the specific architecture (e.g. x86) used by the CPU of the system.

entries.label: timezoneDST
entries.comment: Specifies the time zone used by the system, taking daylight savings time (DST) into account.

entries.label: timezoneStandard
entries.comment: Specifies the time zone used by the system, without taking daylight savings time (DST) into account.

entries.label: uptime
entries.comment: Specifies the duration that represents the current amount of time that the system has been up.

entries.label: contactAddressScope
entries.comment: Contact address scope specifies the relevant scope (home, work, school, etc) for a geolocation address of a contact entity.

entries.label: organizationDepartment
entries.comment: Specifies a particular suborganization (division, branch, office, etc.) that exists within a larger organization.

entries.label: organizationPosition
entries.comment: Specifies the title or role that a person plays within an organization.

entries.label: contactEmailScope
entries.comment: Contact email scope specifies the relevant scope (home, work, school, etc) of details for contacting a contact entity by email.

entries.label: lastTimeContacted
entries.comment: Last time contacted specifies the date and time that a particular contact was last contacted.

entries.label: numberTimesContacted
entries.comment: Number times contacted specifies the number of times a particular contact has been contacted.

entries.label: contactID
entries.comment: Specifies an ID for the contact.

entries.label: displayName
entries.comment: Display name specifies the name to display for some entity within a user interface.

entries.label: firstName
entries.comment: The first name of a person.

entries.label: lastName
entries.comment: The last name of a person.

entries.label: middleName
entries.comment: The middle name of a person.

entries.label: namePhonetic
entries.comment: Name phonetic specifies the phonetic pronunciation of the name of a person.

entries.label: namePrefix
entries.comment: Name prefix specifies an honorific prefix (coming ordinally before first/given name) for the name of a person.

entries.label: nameSuffix
entries.comment: Name suffix specifies an suffix (coming ordinally after last/family name) for the name of a person.

entries.label: contactGroup
entries.comment: Contact group specifies the name/tag of a particular named/tagged grouping of contacts.

entries.label: contactNote
entries.comment: Contact note specifies a comment/note associated with a given contact.

entries.label: nickname
entries.comment: Nickname specifies an alternate, unofficial and typically informal name for a person independent of their official name.

entries.label: contactPhoneScope
entries.comment: Contact phone scope specifies the relevant scope (home, work, school, etc) of details for contacting a contact entity by telephone.

entries.label: contactSIPScope
entries.comment: Contact SIP scope specifies the relevant scope (home, work, school, etc) of details for contacting a contact entity by Session Initiation Protocol (SIP).

entries.label: contactURLScope
entries.comment: Contact url scope specifies the relevant scope (homepage, home, work, school, etc) of details for contacting a contact entity by Uniform Resource Locator (URL).

entries.label: entropy
entries.comment: Shannon entropy (a measure of randomness) of the data.

entries.label: sizeInBytes
entries.comment: The size of the data in bytes.

entries.label: mimeType
entries.comment: MIME type of the data. For example 'text/html' or 'audio/mp3'.

entries.label: rangeOffset
entries.comment: The offset at which the start of data can be found, relative to the rangeOffsetType defined.

entries.label: rangeSize
entries.comment: The size of the data in bytes.

entries.label: rangeOffsetType
entries.comment: The type of offset defined for the range (e.g., image, file, address).

entries.label: cpeid
entries.comment: Specifies the Common Platform Enumeration identifier for the software.

entries.label: isDisabled
entries.comment: Is the digital account disabled?

entries.label: firstLoginTime
entries.comment: The date and time of the first login of the account.

entries.label: lastLoginTime
entries.comment: The date and time of the last login of the account.

entries.label: accountLogin
entries.comment: The login identifier for the digital account.

entries.label: addressValue
entries.comment: The value of an address.

entries.label: diskSize
entries.comment: The size of the disk, in bytes.

entries.label: freeSpace
entries.comment: The amount of free space on the disk, in bytes.

entries.label: diskType
entries.comment: The type of disk being characterized, e.g., removable.

entries.label: partitionLength
entries.comment: Specifies the length of the partition, in bytes.

entries.label: partitionOffset
entries.comment: Specifies the starting offset of the partition, in bytes.

entries.label: spaceLeft
entries.comment: Specifies the amount of space left on the partition, in bytes.

entries.label: spaceUsed
entries.comment: Specifies the amount of space used on the partition, in bytes.

entries.label: totalSpace
entries.comment: Specifies the total amount of space available on the partition, in bytes.

entries.label: diskPartitionType
entries.comment: Specifies the type of partition being characterized.

entries.label: mountPoint
entries.comment: Specifies the mount point of the partition.

entries.label: partitionID
entries.comment: Specifies the identifier of the partition, as provided by the containing partition table.  This identifier is the index value within the partition table, and is expected to be an incrementing alphanumeric value (numeric in most partition systems), not a GUID or UUID.  Sorting partitions by this index should first attempt to sort a numeric cast of the value.

entries.label: ESN
entries.comment: Electronic Serial Number .

entries.label: receivedTime
entries.comment: The date and time at which the message received.

entries.label: sentTime
entries.comment: The date and time at which the message sent.

entries.label: inReplyTo
entries.comment: One of more unique identifiers for identifying the email(s) this email is a reply to.

entries.label: messageID
entries.comment: An unique identifier for the message.

entries.label: priority
entries.comment: The priority of the email.

entries.label: categories
entries.comment: Categories applied to the object.

entries.label: labels
entries.comment: Named and colored label.

entries.label: eventRecordID
entries.comment: The identifier of the event record.

entries.label: eventRecordRaw
entries.comment: The complete raw content of the event record.

entries.label: eventServiceName
entries.comment: The service that generated the event record. A single application can have multiple services generating event records.

entries.label: eventRecordText
entries.comment: The textual representation of the event.

entries.label: extDeletionTime
entries.comment: Specifies the time at which the file represented by an Inode was 'deleted'.

entries.label: extInodeChangeTime
entries.comment: The date and time at which the file Inode metadata was last modified.

entries.label: extFileType
entries.comment: Specifies the EXT file type (FIFO, Directory, Regular file, Symbolic link, etc) for the Inode.

entries.label: extFlags
entries.comment: Specifies user flags to further protect (limit its use and modification) the file represented by an Inode.

entries.label: extHardLinkCount
entries.comment: Specifies a count of how many hard links point to an Inode.

entries.label: extInodeID
entries.comment: Specifies a single Inode identifier.

entries.label: extPermissions
entries.comment: Specifies the read/write/execute permissions for the file represented by an EXT Inode.

entries.label: extSGID
entries.comment: Specifies the group ID for the file represented by an Inode.

entries.label: extSUID
entries.comment: Specifies the user ID that 'owns' the file represented by an Inode.

entries.label: byteStringValue
entries.comment: Specifies the raw, byte-string representation of the extracted string.

entries.label: length
entries.comment: Specifies the length, in characters, of the extracted string.

entries.label: Encoding
entries.comment: The encoding method used for the extracted string.

entries.label: englishTranslation
entries.comment: Specifies the English translation of the string, if it is not written in English.

entries.label: language
entries.comment:
Specifies the language the string is written in, e.g. English.
          For consistency, it is strongly recommended to use the ISO 639-2 language code, if available. Please see http://www.loc.gov/standards/iso639-2/php/code_list.php for a list of ISO 639-2 codes.

entries.label: stringValue
entries.comment: Specifies the actual value of the extracted string.

entries.label: isDirectory
entries.comment: Specifies whether a file entry represents a directory.

entries.label: metadataChangeTime
entries.comment: The date and time at which the file metadata was last modified.

entries.label: allocationStatus
entries.comment: The allocation status of a file.

entries.label: extension
entries.comment: The file name extension: everything after the last dot. Not present if the file has no dot in its name.

entries.label: fileName
entries.comment: Specifies the name associated with a file in a file system.

entries.label: filePath
entries.comment: Specifies the file path for the location of a file within a filesystem.

entries.label: clusterSize
entries.comment: The size of cluster allocation units in a file system.

entries.label: fileSystemType
entries.comment: The specific type of a file system.

entries.label: hexadecimalValue
entries.comment: The hexadecimal value of a global flag. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/hardware/ff549646(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: abbreviation
entries.comment: The abbreviation of a global flag. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/hardware/ff549646(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: destination
entries.comment: The destination of a global flag. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/hardware/ff549646(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: symbolicName
entries.comment: The symbolic name of a global flag. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/hardware/ff549646(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: httpMesageBodyLength
entries.comment: Specifies the length of an HTTP message body in bytes.

entries.label: requestMethod
entries.comment: Specifies the HTTP method portion of the HTTP request line, as a lowercase string.

entries.label: requestValue
entries.comment: Specifies the value (typically a resource path) portion of the HTTP request line.

entries.label: requestVersion
entries.comment: Specifies the HTTP version portion of the HTTP request line, as a lowercase string.

entries.label: ICCID
entries.comment: Integrated circuit card identifier (http://www.itu.int/).

entries.label: icmpCode
entries.comment: Specifies the ICMP code byte.

entries.label: icmpType
entries.comment: Specifies the ICMP type byte.

entries.label: comClassID
entries.comment: Specifies the ID of the COM action. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa380613(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: comData
entries.comment: Specifies the data associated with the COM handler. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa380613(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: execArguments
entries.comment: Specifies the arguments associated with the command-line operation launched by the action. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa380715(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: execProgramPath
entries.comment: Specifies the path to the executable file launched by the action. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa380715(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: execWorkingDirectory
entries.comment: Specifies the directory that contains either the executable file or the files that are used by the executable file launched by the action. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa380715(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: IMEI
entries.comment: International Mobile Equipment Identity (IMEI).

entries.label: IMSI
entries.comment: An International Mobile Subscriber Identity (IMSI) is a unique identification associated with all GSM and UMTS network mobile phone users. It is stored as a 64-bit field in the SIM inside the phone and is sent by the phone to the network.

entries.label: showMessageBody
entries.comment: Specifies the message text that is displayed in the body of the message box by the action. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381302(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: showMessageTitle
entries.comment: Specifies the title of the message box shown by the action. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381302(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: imageType
entries.comment: The type of the image, e.g. EnCase, RAW or LocalFolder.

entries.label: libraryType
entries.comment: Specifies the type of library being characterized.

entries.label: MSISDN
entries.comment: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN) is a number used to identify a mobile phone number internationally. MSISDN is defined by the E.164 numbering plan. This number includes a country code and a National Destination Code which identifies the subscriber's operator.

entries.label: isInjected
entries.comment: The isInjected property specifies whether or not the particular memory object has had data/code injected into it by another process.

entries.label: isMapped
entries.comment: The isMapped property specifies whether or not the particular memory object has been assigned a byte-for-byte correlation with some portion of a file or file-like resource.

entries.label: isProtected
entries.comment: The isProtected property specifies whether or not the particular memory object is protected (read/write only from the process that allocated it).

entries.label: isVolatile
entries.comment: The isVolatile property specifies whether or not the particular memory object is volatile.

entries.label: regionEndAddress
entries.comment: The regionEndAddress property specifies the ending address of the particular memory region.

entries.label: regionStartAddress
entries.comment: The regionStartAddress property specifies the starting address of the particular memory region.

entries.label: regionSize
entries.comment: The regionSize property specifies the size of the particular memory region, in bytes.

entries.label: blockType
entries.comment: The blockType property specifies the block type of a particular memory object.

entries.label: messageText
entries.comment: The contents of the message.

entries.label: messageType
entries.comment: Message type specifies what sort of message (email, chat, SMS, etc) a Message is.

entries.label: sessionID
entries.comment: An identifier for the session from which the message originates.

entries.label: mftFileNameAccessedTime
entries.comment: The access date and time recorded in an MFT entry $File_Name attribute.

entries.label: mftFileNameCreatedTime
entries.comment: The creation date and time recorded in an MFT entry $File_Name attribute.

entries.label: mftFileNameModifiedTime
entries.comment: The modification date and time recorded in an MFT entry $File_Name attribute.

entries.label: mftFileNameRecordChangeTime
entries.comment: The metadata modification date and time recorded in an MFT entry $File_Name attribute.

entries.label: mftRecordChangeTime
entries.comment: The date and time at which an NTFS file metadata was last modified.

entries.label: mftFileID
entries.comment: Specifies the record number for the file within an NTFS Master File Table.

entries.label: mftFileNameLength
entries.comment: Specifies the length of an NTFS file name, in unicode characters.

entries.label: mftFlags
entries.comment: Specifies basic permissions for the file (Read-Only, Hidden, Archive, Compressed, etc.).

entries.label: mftParentID
entries.comment: Specifies the record number within an NTFS Master File Table for parent directory of the file.

entries.label: ntfsHardLinkCount
entries.comment: Specifies the number of directory entries that reference an NTFS file record.

entries.label: ntfsOwnerID
entries.comment: Specifies the identifier of the file owner, from the security index.

entries.label: ntfsOwnerSID
entries.comment: Specifies the security ID (key in the $SII Index and $SDS DataStream in the file $Secure) for an NTFS file.

entries.label: clockSetting
entries.comment: The generalizedTime value on the mobile device when it was processed.

entries.label: phoneActivationTime
entries.comment: The date and time that a device was activated.

entries.label: storageCapacityInBytes
entries.comment: The number of bytes that can be stored on a SIM card.

entries.label: bluetoothDeviceName
entries.comment: Name configured within Bluetooth settings on a device.

entries.label: keypadUnlockCode
entries.comment: A code or password set on a device for security that must be entered to gain access to the device.

entries.label: mutexName
entries.comment: Specifies the name identifier for a specific instance of a mechanism that enforces limits on access to a resource when there are many threads of execution .

entries.label: entryID
entries.comment: A unique identifier for the file within the filesystem.

entries.label: destinationPort
entries.comment: Specifies the destination port used in the connection, as an integer in the range of 0 - 65535.

entries.label: sourcePort
entries.comment: Specifies the source port used in the connection, as an integer in the range of 0 - 65535.

entries.label: dhcpLeaseExpires
entries.comment: Specifies the date/time that the DHCP lease obtained on the network interface expires.

entries.label: dhcpLeaseObtained
entries.comment: Specifies the date/time that the DHCP lease was obtained on the network interface.

entries.label: adapterName
entries.comment: Specifies the name of the network adapter used by the network interface.

entries.label: isLimitAdTrackingEnabled
entries.comment: Limits advertising tracking if enabled. [based on https://developer.android.com/reference/androidx/ads/identifier/AdvertisingIdInfo]

entries.label: bitness
entries.comment: Specifies the bitness of the operating system (i.e. 32 or 64). Note that this is potentially different from the word size of the underlying hardware or CPU. A 32-bit operating system can be installed on a machine running a 64-bit processor.

entries.label: advertisingID
entries.comment: Advertising ID as a UUID. [based on https://developer.android.com/reference/androidx/ads/identifier/AdvertisingIdInfo]

entries.label: pdfCreationDate
entries.comment: The PDF CreationDate property is defined in ISO 32000-1:2008 as 'The date and time the document was created, in human-readable form' (Table 317).  As a UCO property, its value is converted to xsd:dateTime.

entries.label: pdfModDate
entries.comment: The PDF ModDate property is defined in ISO 32000-1:2008 as 'The date and time the document was most recently modified, in human-readable form' (Table 317).  As a UCO property, its value is converted to xsd:dateTime.

entries.label: PIN
entries.comment: Personal Identification Number (PIN).

entries.label: PUK
entries.comment: Personal Unlocking Key (PUK) to unlock the SIM card.

entries.label: path
entries.comment: Specifies the location of one object within another containing object.

entries.label: phoneNumber
entries.comment: A phone number(account).

entries.label: isHidden
entries.comment: The isHidden property specifies whether the process is hidden or not.

entries.label: exitTime
entries.comment: The time at which the process exited.

entries.label: exitStatus
entries.comment: A small number passed from the process to the parent process when it has finished executing. In general, 0 indicates successful termination, any other number indicates a failure.

entries.label: pid
entries.comment: The Process ID, or PID, of the process.

entries.label: status
entries.comment: Specifies a list of statuses for a given Whois entry.

entries.label: arguments
entries.comment: A list of arguments utilized in initiating the process.

entries.label: Profile Created
entries.comment: Specifies the date and time the profile was created.

entries.label: Profile Language
entries.comment: Specifies the language associated with the profile. When present, it MUST be a language code conformant to RFC 5646/BCP47.

entries.label: properties
entries.comment: Specifies the properties that were enumerated as a result of the action on the observable object.

entries.label: propertyName
entries.comment: Specifies the Name of the property being read.

entries.label: pictureWidth
entries.comment: The width of the picture in pixels.

entries.label: pictureType
entries.comment: The type of a picture, for example a thumbnail.

entries.label: contentRecoveredStatus
entries.comment: Specifies the recoverability status of the content of an object.

entries.label: metadataRecoveredStatus
entries.comment: Specifies the recoverability status of the metadata of an object.

entries.label: nameRecoveredStatus
entries.comment: Specifies the recoverability status of the name of an object.

entries.label: SIMForm
entries.comment: The form of SIM card such as SIM, Micro SIM, Nano SIM.

entries.label: SIMType
entries.comment: The type of SIM card such as SIM, USIM, UICC.

entries.label: tableName
entries.comment: The table containing a specified database record.

entries.label: controlCode
entries.comment: Specifies the actual control code that was sent to the observable object.

entries.label: swid
entries.comment: Specifies the SWID tag for the software.

entries.label: totalStorageCapacityInBytes
entries.comment: The maximum number of bytes that can be stored on a storage device.

entries.label: destinationFlags
entries.comment: Specifies the destination TCP flags.

entries.label: sourceFlags
entries.comment: Specifies the source TCP flags.

entries.label: recordFieldIsNull
entries.comment: Whether the specified database record field is null.

entries.label: recordFieldName
entries.comment: A field name of a database record value being identified.

entries.label: tableSchema
entries.comment: The schema that contains the identified database record.

entries.label: recordFieldValue
entries.comment: The field value of a specified database record.

entries.label: recordRowID
entries.comment: The unique ID that identifies a database record, supplied by the originating database engine.

entries.label: actionID
entries.comment: Specifies the user-defined identifier for the action. This identifier is used by the Task Scheduler for logging purposes. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa380590(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: actionType
entries.comment: Specifies the type of the action. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa380596(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: isEnabled
entries.comment: Specifies whether the trigger is enabled.

entries.label: triggerBeginTime
entries.comment: Specifies the date/time that the trigger is activated.

entries.label: triggerEndTime
entries.comment: Specifies the date/time that the trigger is deactivated.

entries.label: triggerDelay
entries.comment: Specifies the delay that takes place between when the task is registered and when the task is started.

entries.label: triggerMaxRunTime
entries.comment: The maximum amount of time that the task launched by the trigger is allowed to run. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa383868(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: triggerSessionChangeType
entries.comment: Specifies the type of Terminal Server session change that would trigger a task launch. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381298(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: triggerFrequency
entries.comment: Specifies the frequency at which the trigger repeats.

entries.label: triggerType
entries.comment: Specifies the type of the task trigger.

entries.label: Is_Protected

entries.label: Is_Verified
entries.comment: Specifies whether the twitter profile is verified.

entries.label: listedCount
entries.comment: Specifies the number of public lists that this profile is associated with.

entries.label: Favorites Count
entries.comment: Specifies the number of times that this profile has favorited a tweet.

entries.label: Followers Count
entries.comment: Specifies the followers count associated with the twitter profile.

entries.label: Friends Count
entries.comment: Specifies the friends count associated with the twitter profile.

entries.label: Statuses Count
entries.comment: Specifies the number of tweets that this profile has issued.

entries.label: Twitter Handle
entries.comment: Specifies the twitter handle associated with the profile.

entries.label: Twitter ID
entries.comment: Specifies the twitter id associated with the profile.

entries.label: User Location String
entries.comment: Specifies the user-provided location string associated with the profile.

entries.label: openFileDescriptor
entries.comment: Specifies a listing of the current file descriptors used by the Unix process.

entries.label: ruid
entries.comment: Specifies the real user ID, which represents the Unix user who created the process.

entries.label: options
entries.comment: Specifies any options used when mounting the volume.

entries.label: port
entries.comment: Port on which communication takes place.

entries.label: fragment
entries.comment: Fragment pointing to a specific part in the resource.

entries.label: fullValue
entries.comment: The full string value of the URL.

entries.label: query
entries.comment: Query passed to the resource.

entries.label: scheme
entries.comment: Identifies the type of URL.

entries.label: userName
entries.comment: Username used to authenticate to this resource.

entries.label: First Visit Time
entries.comment: Specifies the date/time that the URL referred to by the URL field was first visited.

entries.label: Last Visit Time
entries.comment: Specifies the date/time that the URL referred to by the URL field was last visited.

entries.label: Manually-Entered Count
entries.comment: Specifies the number of times the URL referred to by the URL field was manually entered into the browser's address field by the user. This field is only applicable for URL history entries generated by Google's Chrome browser.

entries.label: Browser User Profile
entries.comment: Specifies the web browser user profile for which the URL history entry was created.

entries.label: Page Title
entries.comment: Specifies the title of a web page.

entries.label: Keyword Search Term
entries.comment: Specifies a string representing a keyword search term contained within the URL field.

entries.label: Visit Time
entries.comment: Specifies the date/time of a specific visit of a URL within a particular browser.

entries.label: Visit Duration
entries.comment: Specifies the duration of a specific visit of a URL within a particular browser.

entries.label: Transition Type
entries.comment: Specifies how a browser navigated to a particular URL on a particular visit.

entries.label: loginTime
entries.comment: Specifies the date/time of the login for the user session.

entries.label: logoutTime
entries.comment: Specifies the date/time of the logout for the user session.

entries.label: effectiveGroup
entries.comment: Specifies the name of the effective group used in the user session.

entries.label: effectiveGroupID
entries.comment: Specifies the effective group ID of the group used in the user session.

entries.label: values
entries.comment: The values that were enumerated as a result of the action on the object.

entries.label: sectorSize
entries.comment: The sector size of the volume in bytes.

entries.label: volumeID
entries.comment: The unique identifier of the volume.

entries.label: creationDate
entries.comment: Specifies the date in which the registered domain was created.

entries.label: expirationDate
entries.comment: Specifies the date in which the registered domain will expire.

entries.label: lookupDate
entries.comment: Specifies the date and time that the Whois record was queried.

entries.label: updatedDate
entries.comment: Specifies the date in which the registered domain information was last updated.

entries.label: domainID
entries.comment: Specifies the domain id for the domain associated with a Whois entry.

entries.label: remarks
entries.comment: Specifies any remarks associated with this Whois entry.

entries.label: sponsoringRegistrar
entries.comment: Specifies the name of the sponsoring registrar for a domain.

entries.label: registrantIDs
entries.comment: Specifies the registrant IDs associated with a domain lookup.

entries.label: dnssec
entries.comment: Specifies the DNSSEC property associated with a Whois entry. Acceptable values are: 'Signed' or 'Unsigned'.

entries.label: whoisContactType
entries.comment: Specifies what type of WHOIS contact this is.

entries.label: registrarGUID
entries.comment: Specifies the Registrar GUID field of a Whois entry.

entries.label: registrarID
entries.comment: Specifies the Registrar ID field of a Whois entry.

entries.label: registrarName
entries.comment: The name of the registrar organization.

entries.label: lastShutdownDate
entries.comment: Specifies the date on which the device was last shutdown.

entries.label: osInstallDate
entries.comment: Specifies the date on which the operating system (OS) was installed.

entries.label: osLastUpgradeDate
entries.comment: Specifies the date on which the operating system (OS) was last upgraded.

entries.label: msProductID
entries.comment: The Microsoft Product ID. See also: http://support.microsoft.com/gp/pidwin.

entries.label: msProductName
entries.comment: The Microsoft ProductName of the current installation of Windows. This is typically found in HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion!ProductName.

entries.label: netBIOSName
entries.comment: Specifies the NetBIOS (Network Basic Input/Output System) name of the Windows system. This is not the same as the host name.

entries.label: domain
entries.comment: The domain(s) that the system belongs to.

entries.label: timeDateStamp
entries.comment: Specifies the time when the PE binary was created.

entries.label: pointerToSymbolTable
entries.comment: Specifies the file offset of the COFF symbol table.

entries.label: numberOfSections
entries.comment: Specifies the number of sections in the PE binary, as a non-negative integer.

entries.label: numberOfSymbols
entries.comment: Specifies the number of entries in the symbol table of the PE binary, as a non-negative integer.

entries.label: sizeOfOptionalHeader
entries.comment: Specifies the size of the optional header of the PE binary.

entries.label: impHash
entries.comment: Specifies the special import hash, or â€˜imphashâ€™, calculated for the PE Binary based on its imported libraries and functions.

entries.label: peType
entries.comment: Specifies the type of the PE binary.

entries.label: machine
entries.comment: Specifies the type of target machine.

entries.label: characteristics
entries.comment: Specifies the flags that indicate the fileâ€™s characteristics.

entries.label: majorLinkerVersion
entries.comment: Specifies the linker major version number.

entries.label: minorLinkerVersion
entries.comment: Specifies the linker minor version number.

entries.label: addressOfEntryPoint
entries.comment: Specifies the address of the entry point relative to the image base when the executable is loaded into memory.

entries.label: baseOfCode
entries.comment: Specifies the address that is relative to the image base of the beginning-of-code section when it is loaded into memory.

entries.label: checksum
entries.comment: Specifies the checksum of the PE binary.

entries.label: fileAlignment
entries.comment: Specifies the factor (in bytes) that is used to align the raw data of sections in the image file.

entries.label: imageBase
entries.comment: Specifies the address that is relative to the image base of the beginning-of-data section when it is loaded into memory.

entries.label: loaderFlags
entries.comment: Specifies the reserved loader flags

entries.label: numberOfRVAAndSizes
entries.comment: Specifies the number of data-directory entries in the remainder of the optional header.

entries.label: sectionAlignment
entries.comment: Specifies the alignment (in bytes) of PE sections when they are loaded into memory.

entries.label: sizeOfCode
entries.comment: Specifies the size of the code (text) section. If there are multiple such sections, this refers to the sum of the sizes of each section.

entries.label: sizeOfHeaders
entries.comment: Specifies the combined size of the MS-DOS, PE header, and section headers, rounded up a multiple of the value specified in the file_alignment header.

entries.label: sizeOfHeapCommit
entries.comment: Specifies the size of the local heap space to commit.

entries.label: sizeOfHeapReserve
entries.comment: Specifies the size of the local heap space to reserve.

entries.label: sizeOfImage
entries.comment: Specifies the size, in bytes, of the image, including all headers, as the image is loaded in memory.

entries.label: sizeOfInitializedData
entries.comment: Specifies the size of the initialized data section. If there are multiple such sections, this refers to the sum of the sizes of each section.

entries.label: sizeOfStackCommit
entries.comment: Specifies the size of the stack to commit.

entries.label: sizeOfStackReserve
entries.comment: Specifies the size of the stack to reserve.

entries.label: sizeOfUninitializedData
entries.comment: Specifies the size of the uninitialized data section. If there are multiple such sections, this refers to the sum of the sizes of each section.

entries.label: win32VersionValue
entries.comment: Specifies the reserved win32 version value.

entries.label: dllCharacteristics
entries.comment: Specifies the flags that characterize the PE binary.

entries.label: magic
entries.comment: Specifies the value that indicates the type of the PE binary.

entries.label: majorImageVersion
entries.comment: Specifies the major version number of the image.

entries.label: majorOSVersion
entries.comment: Specifies the major version number of the required operating system.

entries.label: majorSubsystemVersion
entries.comment: Specifies the major version number of the subsystem.

entries.label: minorImageVersion
entries.comment: Specifies the minor version number of the image.

entries.label: minorOSVersion
entries.comment: Specifies the minor version number of the required operating system.

entries.label: minorSubsystemVersion
entries.comment: Specifies the minor version number of the subsystem.

entries.label: subsystem
entries.comment: Specifies the subsystem (e.g., GUI, device driver, etc.) that is required to run this image.

entries.label: firstRun
entries.comment: Timestamp of when the prefetch application was first run.

entries.label: lastRun
entries.comment: Timestamp of when the prefetch application was last run.

entries.label: timesExecuted
entries.comment: The number of times the prefetch application has executed.

entries.label: applicationFileName
entries.comment: Name of the executable of the prefetch file.

entries.label: prefetchHash
entries.comment: An eight character hash of the location from which the application was run.

entries.label: hiveType
entries.comment: The type of a registry hive.

entries.label: nextRunTime
entries.comment: Specifies the next run date/time of the scheduled task. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381257(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: exitCode
entries.comment: Specifies the last exit code of the scheduled task. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381245(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: maxRunTime
entries.comment: Specifies the maximum run time of the scheduled task before terminating, in milliseconds. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381874(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: accountLogonType
entries.comment: Specifies the security logon method required to run the tasks associated with the account. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa383013(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: accountRunLevel
entries.comment: Specifies the permission level of the account that the task will be run at.

entries.label: imageName
entries.comment: Specifies the image name for the task.

entries.label: parameters
entries.comment: Specifies the command line parameters used to launch the scheduled task. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381875(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: taskComment
entries.comment: Specifies a comment for the scheduled task. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381232(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: taskCreator
entries.comment: Specifies the name of the creator of the scheduled task. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381235(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: flags
entries.comment: Specifies any flags that modify the behavior of the scheduled task. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381248(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: driveLetter
entries.comment: Specifies the drive letter of a windows volume.

entries.label: driveType
entries.comment: Specifies the drive type of a windows volume.

entries.label: windowsVolumeAttributes
entries.comment: Specifies the attributes of a windows volume.

entries.label: baseStation
entries.comment: The base station.

entries.label: wirelessNetworkSecurityMode
entries.comment: Specifies the security mode of a wireless network (None, WEP, WPA, etc).

entries.comment: Specifies an action that shows a message box when a task is activated. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381302(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: iEmailAction
entries.comment: Specifies an action that sends an e-mail, which in this context refers to actual email message sent. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa380693(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: Profile Background Location
entries.comment: Specifies the network location of the background associated with the profile.

entries.label: Profile Banner Location
entries.comment: Specifies the network location of the banner associated with the profile.

entries.label: Profile Image Location
entries.comment: Specifies the network location of the profile image associated with the profile.

entries.label: Profile Background Hash
entries.comment: Specifies hashes of the background associated with the profile.

entries.label: Profile Banner Hash
entries.comment: Specifies hashes of the banner associated with the profile.

entries.label: Profile Image Hash
entries.comment: Specifies hashes of the profile image associated with the profile.

entries.label: host
entries.comment: Domain name or IP address where the resource is located.

entries.label: referrerURL
entries.comment: Specifies the origination point (i.e., URL) of a URL request.

entries.label: Browser Information
entries.comment: Specifies information about the particular Web Browser.

entries.label: URL History Entries
entries.comment: Specifies a URL history record stored in the browser's history.

entries.label: From URL Visit
entries.comment: Specifies the URL visit origination point (i.e., URL) of the URL captured in the URL history entry, if applicable.

entries.label: effectiveUser
entries.comment: Specifies the effective user details used in the user session.

entries.label: domainName
entries.comment: Specifies the corresponding domain name for a whois entry.

entries.label: ipAddress
entries.comment: Specifies the corresponding ip address for a whois entry. Usually corresponds to a name server lookup.

entries.label: registrantContactInfo
entries.comment: Specifies contact info for the registrant of a domain within a WHOIS entity.

entries.label: serverName
entries.comment: Specifies the corresponding server name for a whois entry. This usually corresponds to a name server lookup.

entries.label: nameServer
entries.comment: Specifies a list of name server entries for a Whois entry.

entries.label: registrarInfo
entries.comment: Specifies registrar info that would be returned from a registrar lookup.

entries.label: referralURL
entries.comment: Specifies the corresponding referral URL for a registrar.

entries.label: whoisServer
entries.comment: Specifies the corresponding whois server for a registrar.

entries.label: registeredOrganization
entries.comment: The organization that this copy of Windows is registered to.

entries.label: registeredOwner
entries.comment: The person or organization that is the registered owner of this copy of Windows.

entries.label: globalFlagList
entries.comment: A list of global flags. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/hardware/ff549557(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: windowsDirectory
entries.comment: The Windows_Directory field specifies the fully-qualified path to the Windows install directory.

entries.label: windowsSystemDirectory
entries.comment: The Windows_System_Directory field specifies the fully-qualified path to the Windows system directory.

entries.label: windowsTempDirectory
entries.comment: The Windows_Temp_Directory field specifies the fully-qualified path to the Windows temporary files directory.

entries.label: optionalHeader
entries.comment: Specifies the PE optional header of the PE binary.

entries.label: sections
entries.comment: Specifies metadata about the sections in the PE file.

entries.label: fileHeaderHashes
entries.comment: Specifies any hashes that were computed for the file header.

entries.label: volume
entries.comment: The volume from which the prefetch application was run. If the applicatin was run from multiple volumes, there will be a separate prefetch file for each.

entries.label: accessedDirectory
entries.comment: Directories accessed by the prefetch application during startup.

entries.label: accessedFile
entries.comment: Files (e.g., DLLs and other support files) used by the application during startup.

entries.label: creator
entries.comment: Specifies the name of the creator of the registry key.

entries.label: registryValues
entries.comment: The values that were enumerated as a result of the action on the object.

entries.label: workItemData
entries.comment: Specifies application defined data associated with the scheduled task. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381271(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: workingDirectory
entries.comment: Specifies the working directory for the scheduled task. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa381878(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: actionList
entries.comment: Specifies a list of actions to be performed by the scheduled task.

entries.label: triggerList
entries.comment: Specifies a set of triggers used by the scheduled task. See also: http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa383264(v=vs.85).aspx.

entries.label: issuerHash
entries.comment: A hash calculated on the certificate issuer name.

entries.label: subjectHash
entries.comment: A hash calculated on the certificate subject name.

entries.label: thumbprintHash
entries.comment: A hash calculated on the entire certificate including signature.

entries.label: ActionArgumentFacet
entries.comment: An action argument facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to a single parameter of an action.

entries.label: ActionEstimationFacet
entries.comment: An action estimation facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to decision-focused approximation aspects for an action that may potentially be performed.

entries.label: ActionFrequencyFacet
entries.comment: An action frequency facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to the frequency of occurrence for an action.

entries.label: ActionLifecycle
entries.comment: An action lifecycle is an action pattern consisting of an ordered set of multiple actions or subordinate action lifecycles.

entries.label: ArrayOfAction
entries.comment: An array of action is an ordered list of references to things that may be done or performed.

entries.label: ActionPattern
entries.comment: An action pattern is a grouping of characteristics unique to a combination of actions forming a consistent or characteristic arrangement.

entries.label: Technique
entries.comment: A technique is a class of actions joined by some common characteristics.  The class uco-action:Technique is a metaclass.  A Technique instance is an owl:Class that is a subclass of uco-action:Action.

entries.label: subaction
entries.comment: References to other actions that make up part of a larger more complex action.

entries.label: environment
entries.comment: The environment wherein an action occurs.

entries.label: performer
entries.comment: The primary performer of an action.

entries.label: error
entries.comment: A characterization of the differences between the expected and the actual performance of the action.

entries.label: instrument
entries.comment: The things used to perform an action.

entries.label: object
entries.comment: The things that the action is performed on/against.

entries.label: participant
entries.comment: The supporting (non-primary) performers of an action.

entries.label: result
entries.comment: The things resulting from performing an action.

entries.label: location
entries.comment: The locations where an action occurs.

entries.label: phase
entries.comment: The ordered set of actions or sub action-lifecycles that represent the action lifecycle.

entries.label: action
entries.comment: A characterization of a single action.

entries.label: endTime
entries.comment: The time at which performance of the action ended.

entries.label: startTime
entries.comment: The time at which performance of the action began.

entries.label: actionCount
entries.comment: The number of times that the action was performed.

entries.label: actionStatus
entries.comment: The current state of the action.

entries.label: argumentName
entries.comment: The identifying label of an argument.

entries.label: value
entries.comment: The value of an action parameter.

entries.label: estimatedCost
entries.comment: An estimation of the cost if the action is performed.

entries.label: estimatedEfficacy
entries.comment: An estimation of the effectiveness of the action at achieving its objective if the action is performed.

entries.label: estimatedImpact
entries.comment: An estimation of the impact if the action is performed.

entries.label: objective
entries.comment: The intended purpose for performing the action.

entries.label: rate
entries.comment: The frequency rate for the occurence of an action.

entries.label: scale
entries.comment: The time scale utilized for the frequency rate count for the occurence of an action.

entries.label: units
entries.comment: The units of measure utilized for the frequency rate count for the occurence of an action.

entries.label: trend
entries.comment: A characterization of the frequency trend for the occurence of an action.

entries.label: techniqueID
entries.comment: An identifier for a technique within some cataloguing system.  At the general level of UCO, techniqueID is left optional and minimally-described aside from needing to be Literal-valued.  Specializations of Technique should also consider specializing a corresponding subproperty of techniqueID to enable support of global review of technique identifiers.

entries.label: Analysis
entries.comment: An analysis is an action of detailed examination of something in order to understand its nature, context or essential features.

entries.label: AnalyticResult
entries.comment: An analytic result is a characterization of the understanding resulting from an analysis action.

entries.label: AnalyticResultFacet
entries.comment: An analytic result facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to the results of an analysis action.

entries.label: ArtifactClassification
entries.comment: An artifact classification is a single specific assertion that a particular class of a classification taxonomy applies to something.

entries.label: ArtifactClassificationResultFacet
entries.comment: An artifact classification result facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to the results of an artifact classification analysis action.

entries.label: classificationConfidence
entries.comment: The level of confidence that a classification assertion is correct.

entries.label: class
entries.comment: A specific classification class.

entries.label: originatingAnalysis
entries.comment: The analysis action that resulted in an analytic result.

entries.label: resultContent
entries.comment: Structured content expressing the results of an analysis action.

entries.label: classification
entries.comment: An asserted classification of an analyzed artifact resulting from the analysis.

entries.label: Configuration
entries.comment: A configuration is a grouping of characteristics unique to a set of parameters or initial settings for the use of a tool, application, software, or other cyber object.

entries.label: ConfigurationEntry
entries.comment: A configuration entry is a grouping of characteristics unique to a particular parameter or initial setting for the use of a tool, application, software, or other cyber object.

entries.label: Dependency
entries.comment: A dependency is a grouping of characteristics unique to something that a tool or other software relies on to function as intended.
A single configuration setting entry item for a tool or other software.

entries.label: dependencies
entries.comment: The relevant configuration dependencies for a tool, application, software, or other cyber object.
The structured value of a configuration setting entry instance.

entries.label: isConfigurationOf
entries.comment: The object which has been configured to run in a more specified manner than another object.  This property is expected to have a more specific range when associated with a class, such as a configured Tool having this property have a range of a Tool.

entries.label: usesConfiguration
entries.comment: A configuration used by an object.

entries.label: usageContextAssumptions
entries.comment: Description of the various relevant usage context assumptions for a tool or other software .

entries.label: itemDescription
entries.comment: A description of a configuration setting entry item.

entries.label: itemName
entries.comment: The name of a configuration setting entry item.

entries.label: itemType
entries.comment: The type of a configuration setting entry item.

entries.label: itemValue
entries.comment: The value of a configuration setting entry instance.

entries.label: dependencyDescription
entries.comment: A description of a tool or other software dependency.

entries.label: dependencyType
entries.comment: The type of a tool or other software dependency.

entries.label: AddressFacet
entries.comment: An address facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to an administrative identifier for a geolocation associated with a specific identity.

entries.label: IdentityFacet
entries.comment: An identity facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to a particular aspect of an identity.

entries.label: AffiliationFacet
entries.comment: An affiliation is a grouping of characteristics unique to the established affiliations of an entity.

entries.label: BirthInformationFacet
entries.comment: Birth information is a grouping of characteristics unique to information pertaining to the birth of an entity.

entries.label: CountryOfResidenceFacet
entries.comment: Country of residence is a grouping of characteristics unique to information related to the country, or countries, where an entity resides.

entries.label: EventsFacet
entries.comment: Events is a grouping of characteristics unique to information related to specific relevant things that happen in the lifetime of an entity.

entries.label: IdentifierFacet
entries.comment: Identifier is a grouping of characteristics unique to information that uniquely and specifically identities an entity.

entries.label: Identity
entries.comment: An identity is a grouping of identifying characteristics unique to an individual or organization.

entries.label: LanguagesFacet
entries.comment: Languages is a grouping of characteristics unique to specific syntactically and grammatically standardized forms of communication (human or computer) in which an entity has proficiency (comprehends, speaks, reads, or writes).

entries.label: NationalityFacet
entries.comment: Nationality is a grouping of characteristics unique to the condition of an entity belonging to a particular nation.

entries.label: OccupationFacet
entries.comment: Occupation is a grouping of characteristics unique to the job or profession of an entity.

entries.label: Organization
entries.comment: An organization is a grouping of identifying characteristics unique to a group of people who work together in an organized way for a shared purpose. [based on https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/organization]

entries.label: OrganizationDetailsFacet
entries.comment: Organization details is a grouping of characteristics unique to an identity representing an administrative and functional structure.

entries.label: Person
entries.comment: A person is a grouping of identifying characteristics unique to a human being regarded as an individual. [based on https://www.lexico.com/en/definition/person]

entries.label: PersonalDetailsFacet
entries.comment: Personal details is a grouping of characteristics unique to an identity representing an individual person.

entries.label: PhysicalInfoFacet
entries.comment: Physical info is a grouping of characteristics unique to the outwardly observable nature of an individual person.

entries.label: QualificationFacet
entries.comment: Qualification is a grouping of characteristics unique to particular skills, capabilities or their related achievements (educational, professional, etc.) of an entity.

entries.label: RelatedIdentityFacet
entries.comment: <Needs fleshed out from CIQ>

entries.label: SimpleNameFacet
entries.comment: A simple name facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to the personal name (e.g., Dr. John Smith Jr.) held by an identity.

entries.label: VisaFacet
entries.comment: Visa is a grouping of characteristics unique to information related to a person's ability to enter, leave, or stay for a specified period of time in a country.

entries.label: GPSCoordinatesFacet
entries.comment: A GPS coordinates facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to the expression of quantified dilution of precision (DOP) for an asserted set of geolocation coordinates typically associated with satellite navigation such as the Global Positioning System (GPS).

entries.label: LatLongCoordinatesFacet
entries.comment: A lat long coordinates facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to the expression of a geolocation as the intersection of specific latitude, longitude, and altitude values.

entries.label: Location
entries.comment: A location is a geospatial place, site, or position.

entries.label: SimpleAddressFacet
entries.comment: A simple address facet is a grouping of characteristics unique to a geolocation expressed as an administrative address.

entries.label: hdop
entries.comment: The horizontal dilution of precision of the GPS location.

entries.label: pdop
entries.comment: The positional (3D) dilution of precision of the GPS location.

entries.label: tdop
entries.comment: The temporal dilution of precision of the GPS location.

entries.label: vdop
entries.comment: The vertical dilution of precision of the GPS location.

entries.label: altitude
entries.comment: The altitude coordinate of a geolocation.

entries.label: latitude
entries.comment: The latitude coordinate of a geolocation.

entries.label: longitude
entries.comment: The longitude coordinate of a geolocation.

entries.label: addressType
entries.comment: The type of the address, for instance home or work.

entries.label: country
entries.comment: The name of the geolocation country.

entries.label: locality
entries.comment: The name of the geolocation locality (e.g., city).

entries.label: postalCode
entries.comment: The zip-code.

entries.label: region
entries.comment: The name of the geolocation region (e.g., state).

entries.label: street
entries.comment: The name of the street.

entries.label: GranularMarking
entries.comment: A granular marking is a grouping of characteristics unique to specification of marking definitions (restrictions, permissions, and other guidance for how data can be used and shared) that apply to particular portions of a particular UCO object.

entries.label: MarkingDefinition
entries.comment: A marking definition is a grouping of characteristics unique to the expression of a specific data marking conveying restrictions, permissions, and other guidance for how marked data can be used and shared.

entries.label: License Marking
entries.comment: A license marking is a grouping of characteristics unique to the expression of data marking definitions (restrictions, permissions, and other guidance for how data can be used and shared) to convey details of license restrictions that apply to the data.

entries.label: MarkingModel
entries.comment: A marking model is a grouping of characteristics unique to the expression of a particular form of data marking definitions (restrictions, permissions, and other guidance for how data can be used and shared).

entries.label: Release-To Marking
entries.comment: A release-to marking is a grouping of characteristics unique to the expression of data marking definitions (restrictions, permissions, and other guidance for how data can be used and shared) to convey details of authorized persons and/or organizations to which to the associated content may be released. The existence of the Release-To marking restricts access to ONLY those identities explicitly…

entries.label: Statement Marking
entries.comment: A statement marking is a grouping of characteristics unique to the expression of data marking definitions (restrictions, permissions, and other guidance for how data can be used and shared) to convey details of a textual marking statement, (e.g., copyright) whose semantic meaning should apply to the associated content. Statement markings are generally not machine-readable. An example of this…

entries.label: Terms Of Use Marking
entries.comment: A terms of use marking is a grouping of characteristics unique to the expression of data marking definitions (restrictions, permissions, and other guidance for how data can be used and shared) to convey details of a textual statement specifying the Terms of Use (that is, the conditions under which the content may be shared, applied, or otherwise used) of the marked content. An example of this…

entries.label: contentSelectors
entries.comment:
Explicit specification of exactly which portions of a UCO object to apply marking definitions to.
  Specific syntax for how to specify the UCO object portions is dependent on the particular syntactic serialization implementation (XML, JSON, etc.) of UCO and MUST be explicitly specified in a separate binding specification for that syntactic serialization implementation (e.g. a UCO XML Binding…

entries.label: definitionType
entries.comment: Specifies the Marking Model for a Marking Definition.

entries.label: License
entries.comment: Specifies the identifier for the type of license

entries.label: Authorized Identities
entries.comment: Specifies the identities that are authorized to access the data to which the data marking is associated.  The list of authorized identities are represented as UUIDs.

entries.label: Statement
entries.comment: Specifies the statement to apply to the structure for which the Marking is to be applied.

entries.label: Terms of Use
entries.comment: Specifies the terms of use that apply to the structure for which the Marking is to be applied.

entries.label: marking
entries.comment: Represents specific marking definitions to be applied to UCO data.

entries.label: definition
entries.comment: Explicit specification of a data marking instance.

entries.label: LogicalPattern
entries.comment: A logical pattern is a grouping of characteristics unique to an informational pattern expressed via a structured pattern expression following the rules of logic.

entries.label: Pattern
entries.comment: A pattern is a combination of properties, acts, tendencies, etc., forming a consistent or characteristic arrangement.

entries.label: PatternExpression
entries.comment: A pattern expression is a grouping of characteristics unique to an explicit logical expression defining a pattern (e.g., regular expression, SQL Select expression, etc.).

entries.label: patternExpression
entries.comment: An explicit logical pattern expression.

entries.label: BenevolentRole
entries.comment: A benevolent role is a role with positive and/or beneficial intent.

entries.label: Role
